text.arabic_uthmani: فَعَتَوْا۟ عَنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّهِمْ فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّٰعِقَةُ وَهُمْ يَنظُرُونَ

words.gloss_range: consequential and sequential connector opening the ayah from the prior warning frame
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa-}}) does not start a detached report; it pulls 51:43 directly into Thamud's response, with sequence and consequence both audible. It also prepares the ayah's doubled fa pattern, so warning, rebellion, and seizure move as a compressed escalation rather than as spacious narration.

topics.headline: opening consequence from the prior warning
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the verse begin as the immediate answer to the reprieve in 51:43, not as a new isolated scene.
topics.reason: The particle is aligned as a sequential/consequential conjunction, and the prior-ayah boundary rows give a concrete 51:43 link.

topics.headline: first member of the doubled fa cascade
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first connector sets up the later result connector, making the ayah's grammar perform rapid escalation.
topics.reason: The bundle marks a second fa at word 6 as a result link, so the opening fa legitimately participates in a two-step connective pattern.

words.gloss_range: completed collective insolent overstepping, locally governed by an away-from or against prepositional frame
words.root_gloss_range: rare root field of arrogant excess and boundary-breaking; local Form I perfect selects communal defiance rather than generic disobedience
words.prose: {{ar:عَتَوْا}} ({{tr:ʿataw}}) makes Thamud's response a completed collective act of arrogant excess, not a neutral failure to comply. The root {{ar:ع ت و}} ({{tr:ʿ-t-w}}) keeps boundary-breaking in view, with a punishment-register echo to destructive excess in 69:6, while the following prepositional frame makes that excess move away from the Lord's command. The same group then shifts from acting subject to seized object and final witness, and the same-surah punishment setting beside Pharaoh's seizure in 51:40 keeps the act within a nearby judgment sequence.

topics.headline: completed communal overstepping
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the rebellion as a completed communal act of insolence, not as scattered hesitation or pending disobedience.
topics.reason: QAC identifies a perfect active 3mp Form I verb with Thamud as the recovered subject, supporting a completed collective reading.

topics.headline: defiance governed away from command
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the syntax makes the command the point they depart from and oppose, not just an object they violate.
topics.reason: The verb instance and attachment evidence force the prepositional complement, preserving the row's separation and opposition payoff.

topics.headline: rare excess root in punishment settings
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears Thamud's moral excess as part of a small punishment vocabulary that also touches destructive force in 69:6.
topics.reason: The root-family echo is meaningful, but local grammar selects human defiance here, so natural-force parallels remain resonance rather than local sense.

topics.headline: same referent reverses roles
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can track one group moving from rebels who act to patients who are seized and witnesses who watch.
topics.reason: Cross-reference evidence keeps the 3mp subject, later object suffix, and final pronoun tied to the same Thamud referent.

topics.headline: defiance personalized by the Lord relation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the act as defiance of a sustaining Lord-relation, not free-floating arrogance.
topics.reason: The following construct phrase identifies the command as belonging to their Lord, so the rebellion verb is locally personalized.

topics.headline: same-surah punishment adjacency
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can place this act inside the surah's nearby punishment sequence, including the seizure of Pharaoh in 51:40.
topics.reason: The row gives a concrete same-surah comparison, but it concerns narrative placement rather than a new local sense of the verb.

topics.headline: low-yield sound comment
topics.no_reader_payoff_reason: The sound observation is impressionistic and adds little after the retained lexical excess and immediate-response topics.
topics.reason: The row is not contradicted, but its payoff is decorative compared with the grammar and lexical topics.

words.gloss_range: preposition marking opposition and separation from the command as governed complement of the rebellion verb
words.prose: {{ar:عَنْ}} ({{tr:ʿan}}) is the small word that keeps the rebellion from collapsing into a simple verb-object violation. It makes the command both the target opposed and the point departed from, so distance from authority is built into the clause.

topics.headline: against and away-from frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that defiance is spatially and relationally framed as moving away from the command while opposing it.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence forces the preposition to govern the command noun as complement of the rebellion verb.

topics.headline: low-yield nasal binding
topics.no_reader_payoff_reason: The phonetic observation does not add a distinct reader-facing payoff beyond the retained grammatical dependency.
topics.reason: The grammatical role already accounts for the preposition-content bond more securely.

words.gloss_range: genitive construct noun meaning command, order, or governing affair, locally bound to their Lord
words.root_gloss_range: authority field covering commanding, command, and ordered affair; local gerund/noun is narrowed by construct syntax and prepositional government
words.prose: {{ar:أَمْرِ}} ({{tr:amri}}) is not a loose instruction floating after the verb. As a governed construct noun from {{ar:أ م ر}} ({{tr:ʾ-m-r}}), it names a standing command or ordered affair that belongs to their Lord, so Thamud's excess is measured against a personally sourced divine order; destruction-formula rows show this phrase shape recurring in judgment accounts such as 11:59, 65:8, and 7:77.

topics.headline: command bound by preposition and construct
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the violated command as a definite construct relation, not an anonymous rule.
topics.reason: The noun is genitive under the preposition and definite by construct with the following Lord noun.

topics.headline: command and ordered affair remain live
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the object of defiance is both a concrete directive and the governing order behind it.
topics.reason: The broader root range is valid, but local syntax keeps the range tied to this governed command/order phrase.

topics.headline: command tied to commander
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels that rejecting the command is simultaneously rejecting the authority who issues and owns it.
topics.reason: Subjective and possessive construct readings converge locally on the Lord as source and owner of the command.

topics.headline: violated-command destruction formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the phrase as part of a destruction-account idiom rather than a one-off wording.
topics.reason: The rows provide concrete parallels, including 11:59, 65:8, 7:77, and the same-surah ordering motif at 51:4.

words.gloss_range: singular construct Lord-title with third-person plural possessive suffix, closing the command chain personally
words.root_gloss_range: lordship field of ownership, authority, sustaining care, and nurture; local noun is narrowed to the Lord related to the rebels by suffix
words.prose: {{ar:رَبِّهِمْ}} ({{tr:rabbihim}}) closes the first beat on relation rather than abstraction: the command is their Lord's command. The suffix makes the authority specifically theirs, while {{ar:ر ب ب}} ({{tr:r-b-b}}) keeps lordship, ownership, and sustaining care in the background; formula rows link this possessive Lord-title with other destruction accounts such as 7:77, 11:59, and 91:14. Same-surah rows also let this Lord-relation contrast what the righteous receive in 51:16 and the authority sworn by in 51:23 with the consequence that overtakes rebels here.

topics.headline: their own Lord as command source
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the defied authority as the Lord personally related to the rebels themselves.
topics.reason: The noun is construct-bound and carries the 3mp possessive suffix referring back to the same Thamud group.

topics.headline: same group routed through suffixes and pronouns
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can follow one referent through rebel, possessor, seized object, and watcher roles.
topics.reason: The bundle explicitly resolves the possessive suffix, object suffix, and final pronoun to the same discourse participant.

topics.headline: nurturing authority behind the title
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the irony that the rejected authority is not distant rule but sustaining lordship.
topics.reason: The local word is a noun title, so nurture is retained as root-family pressure rather than promoted to a separate local action.

topics.headline: possessive Lord formula in judgment narratives
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes a repeated destruction pattern where communities defy the Lord specifically related to them.
topics.reason: The rows give concrete destruction parallels at 7:77, 11:59, and 91:14 plus a same-surah Lord thread at 51:16 and 51:23.

topics.headline: same-surah giving and taking contrast
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can contrast what the righteous receive from their Lord in 51:16 with what overtakes rebels here.
topics.reason: The contrast is a valid same-surah resonance, but it does not change the local sense of the Lord-title.

topics.headline: command and Lord form one authority chain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the command phrase close as one tightly governed authority relation.
topics.reason: The singular construct title completes the prior command noun as a compact command-Lord chain.

words.gloss_range: result connector marking the seizure as immediate consequence of the rebellion
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa-}}) is the ayah's internal hinge: it turns completed rebellion into completed seizure with no narrative buffer. Because it repeats the opening connector but now points forward to the punishment clause, the verse moves from response to consequence before the final waw freezes the scene into simultaneity.

topics.headline: seizure as direct result
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the seizure as both immediately after and because of the rebellion.
topics.reason: The attachment layer marks the second clause as a strongly licensed result of the first.

topics.headline: fa reprise before final simultaneity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah's temporal architecture: response, punishment, then frozen witnessing.
topics.reason: The two fa connectors and final waw are all present locally and carry different discourse relations.

words.gloss_range: active perfect seizure verb with feminine agreement and attached third-person plural object suffix
words.root_gloss_range: taking field ranging from receiving or grasping to punitive seizure; local thunderbolt subject and human object select violent judicial capture
words.prose: {{ar:أَخَذَتْهُمُ}} ({{tr:akhadhat-humu}}) makes the rebels into the attached object of the seizure verb, while feminine agreement delays and points to the disaster subject that follows. The root {{ar:أ خ ذ}} ({{tr:ʾ-kh-dh}}) is broad, but here the active verb, thunderbolt subject, and human object select punitive capture; the attached final circumstance makes that capture witnessed as it happens. Same-surah and formula rows sharpen this as the reverse of beneficial taking in 51:16 and as a destruction pattern also seen in 7:78, 11:67, and 29:37.

topics.headline: agreement points to delayed disaster subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the seizure before the agent is named, while agreement already fixes the thunderbolt as the coming subject.
topics.reason: The feminine perfect verb agrees with the following feminine nominative subject and precedes it in VSO order.

topics.headline: rebels become seized object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the same group move from self-asserting agents into the object fused to the verb that overtakes them.
topics.reason: The object suffix is syntactically forced and resumes the same Thamud referent from the prior verb.

topics.headline: broad taking narrowed to punitive capture
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels physical taking and accountability collapse into one act of capture.
topics.reason: The root can cover gentler taking, but the thunderbolt subject and human object force the violent punishment register here.

topics.headline: active verb makes disaster executor
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the disaster is not merely an instrument; it performs the taking in the grammar.
topics.reason: The active verb with the disaster noun as subject licenses the executor payoff.

topics.headline: formulaic seizure in punishment sequence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the seizure as a known punishment formula and as the dark reversal of taking from the Lord in 51:16.
topics.reason: The rows give concrete formula parallels at 7:78, 11:67, and 29:37 and same-surah contrasts at 51:16 and 51:40.

topics.headline: seizure opens into witnessing state
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the taking is immediately overlaid by awareness, making punishment a witnessed event.
topics.reason: The circumstantial clause is attached to the seizure verb and supplies the state in which the object is overtaken.

topics.headline: low-yield onset sound
topics.no_reader_payoff_reason: The acoustic note is plausible but adds no distinct payoff after the retained sudden-result and seizure topics.
topics.reason: The grammatical abruptness is already carried by the result connector and perfect seizure verb.

words.gloss_range: definite active-participle disaster noun, locally the nominative subject that seizes them
words.root_gloss_range: stunning, lightning-strike, fainting, and consciousness-collapse field; local noun selects a definite punitive striking agent
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلصَّٰعِقَةُ}} ({{tr:aṣ-ṣāʿiqatu}}) lands after the verb and object as the delayed subject: the seizure has already been heard, and now the seizing agent is revealed. Its active-participle form makes the disaster a doer, while {{ar:ص ع ق}} ({{tr:ṣ-ʿ-q}}) brings the consciousness-destroying strike into direct tension with the final watching clause; larger root echoes reach theophanic fainting in 7:143 and eschatological stunning in 39:68, while this local case remains terminal punishment. Variant rows test agent versus event and singular blow versus plural strikes, but the local standard form concentrates the scene into one definite stunning agent; the assimilated article and emphatic root cluster make definiteness arrive with an intensified onset.

topics.headline: definite thunderbolt as delayed subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader experiences the disaster noun as the heavy reveal after the verb has already announced seizure.
topics.reason: Case, agreement, and word order all identify the noun as the delayed subject of the prior verb.

topics.headline: active form makes disaster a doer
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the thunderbolt is not a passive label for calamity but a form-marked agent that produces stunning.
topics.reason: The local form tag is active participial and the noun is the grammatical subject of the active seizure verb.

topics.headline: stunning force targets awareness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the disaster as a strike against awareness itself, sharpened by the victims' ongoing perception.
topics.reason: The root field includes stunning and loss of consciousness, and the final circumstantial clause makes perception locally explicit.

topics.headline: variants test agent, event, and number
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees why the standard wording matters: it chooses one active definite striking agent over an event noun or pluralized strikes.
topics.reason: Variant evidence is useful contrast, but the canonical local parse remains the singular definite active-participle noun.

topics.headline: local punishment echoes larger stunning scenes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear Thamud's local destruction against larger root uses for theophanic fainting in 7:143 and eschatological stunning in 39:68.
topics.reason: The cross-references are concrete and relevant, while the local instance remains terminal punishment.

topics.headline: stunning collides with watching
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees form, rarity, placement, and the final watching clause converge on awareness being active at the instant awareness is destroyed.
topics.reason: The noun is the subject that seizes, and the attached circumstantial clause makes the victims' perception simultaneous with that seizure.

topics.headline: compressed emphatic onset and harsh cluster
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that recitation fuses definiteness into an intensified emphatic onset and harsh root cluster.
topics.reason: The surface form contains article assimilation before the emphatic consonant, so the sound payoff is locally anchored.

words.gloss_range: circumstantial waw introducing the watching state simultaneous with the seizure
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa-}}) changes the ayah's motion. After the two fa links have carried warning into rebellion and rebellion into seizure, this connector overlays the victims' watching state onto the event, so the verse stops advancing and freezes destruction as simultaneous awareness. Because it attaches directly to the explicit pronoun frame, the final clause begins by reintroducing the same seized group as witnesses.

topics.headline: waw of circumstance, not simple coordination
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the final clause as the state during seizure, not as another event after it.
topics.reason: The attachment layer identifies the final clause as a circumstantial clause attached to the seizure event.

topics.headline: connector shift freezes the scene
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the movement from causal sequence into a fixed tableau of seizure plus watching.
topics.reason: The prior two connectors are fa links, while this word introduces the simultaneous circumstantial frame.

topics.headline: connector fused to explicit witness referent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader immediately receives both the relation and the reintroduced witness group at the start of the final clause.
topics.reason: The connector attaches directly to the detached pronoun that resumes the seized group.

topics.headline: low-yield nasal bridge
topics.no_reader_payoff_reason: The sound link is minor and does not add a separate payoff beyond the retained circumstantial pronoun-frame topic.
topics.reason: The clause cohesion is better explained by syntax and referent continuity.

words.gloss_range: detached third-person masculine plural pronoun, subject of the nominal circumstantial clause
words.prose: {{ar:هُمْ}} ({{tr:hum}}) gives the final state an explicit subject even though the following verb also carries plural agreement. The detached pronoun makes the seized victims re-enter as witnesses without renaming them after 51:43: the same group that rebelled and was taken now stands visibly inside the nominal circumstantial frame.

topics.headline: detached pronoun opens durative state
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the final clause as a stable state of being, with the witnesses explicitly visible.
topics.reason: The attachment evidence marks the pronoun as the subject of the nominal circumstantial clause.

topics.headline: same victims re-enter as witnesses
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the same people from agents of rebellion to objects of seizure to explicit witnesses.
topics.reason: Cross-reference evidence resolves the detached pronoun to Thamud and links it to the earlier subject and object suffix.

topics.headline: referent carried across the ayah boundary
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the pronoun preserve the exact group without renaming them after the previous verse.
topics.reason: The pronoun is definite and the bundle resolves it to the same antecedent from 51:43.

topics.headline: structural hinge into final image
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the pronoun itself pivots the ayah from action into witnessed condition.
topics.reason: The pronoun opens the nominal clause that functions as the final circumstantial frame.

words.gloss_range: imperfect active third-person plural verb of looking, watching, or waiting, objectless inside the circumstantial clause
words.root_gloss_range: seeing, observing, considering, and waiting or granting delay in related forms; local Form I imperfect selects ongoing perception or expectancy, not the causative granting of respite
words.prose: {{ar:يَنظُرُونَ}} ({{tr:yanẓurūna}}) leaves the ayah on ongoing collective perception rather than on the thunderbolt itself. The imperfect aspect keeps the looking simultaneous with seizure, while the objectless frame lets watching and expectancy remain open; {{ar:ن ظ ر}} ({{tr:n-ẓ-r}}) also brushes against respite language, but the local Form I verb gives no delay, only awareness at the instant it is removed. Destruction-scene parallels such as 7:198 and 36:49 make this open-eyed helplessness recognizable, and the boundary from 51:43's reprieve to this final word collapses suspended time into a witnessed instant.

topics.headline: imperfect aspect keeps watching ongoing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the victims watching during the strike, not glancing afterward.
topics.reason: The imperfect verb is predicate of the circumstantial nominal clause and describes simultaneous ongoing action.

topics.headline: explicit pronoun plus plural ending
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears collective witnessing reinforced by both the pronoun before the verb and the plural ending on the final word.
topics.reason: The verb carries 3mp morphology while an overt detached pronoun supplies the same subject in the clause.

topics.headline: objectless frame leaves seeing and waiting open
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels both open-eyed watching and tense expectancy because no object or preposition narrows what they look toward.
topics.reason: The verb instance is objectless, so the ambiguity is retained, while local Form I keeps the core as perception or expectancy.

topics.headline: respite root pressure reverses into no delay
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the irony that the prior interval has closed: the root can touch waiting or respite, but here no reprieve is granted.
topics.reason: The causative respite branch is not the local form, so the payoff survives only as contrast with the previous reprieve frame.

topics.headline: perception meets consciousness-destroying strike
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees awareness trapped inside the instant that ends awareness.
topics.reason: The final verb names perception while the preceding disaster root names stunning or loss of consciousness.

topics.headline: watching formula in destruction scenes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes open-eyed awareness without agency as a repeated punishment-scene feature, including 7:198 and 36:49.
topics.reason: The rows provide concrete destruction and judgment-scene parallels for the final watching phrase.

topics.headline: looking makes seizure observed
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the punishment is not merely suffered; it is perceived as it arrives.
topics.reason: The co-occurrence rows and local circumstantial attachment place watching beside seizure and stunning.

topics.headline: ayah closes on perception
topics.reader_payoff: The reader exits the ayah with the victims' open awareness as the final image.
topics.reason: The verb is the final word of the ayah and completes the shift from reported reprieve to direct visual consequence.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence joins arrogant departure, the Lord's binding command, seizure, the overhead shock, and contemporaneous looking.
baseline_models.mechanism: A binding sovereign direction is arrogantly refused; the resulting strike is therefore not bare impact but a culpability-linked seizure, and the final looking makes the seized people conscious witnesses within the event.

activation_trace.role: Arrogant departure from obedience supplies the initiating breach.
Binding request and obligation make the rejected matter directive rather than neutral.
Lordship and sovereignty locate authority behind the command.
Taking for a fault converts impact into accountable seizure.
The upper crash supplies the concrete overwhelming event.
Directed sight makes them present witnesses rather than absent objects.

changed_reading.before: A people are struck while they happen to be looking.
changed_reading.after: Their arrogant refusal of binding lordly direction is answered by a culpability-seizure that they consciously witness as it closes over them.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The terminal-state branch of عتو stands against the reparative and formative branch of رب, while أخذ and صعق can describe a bodily condition that overwhelms its subject.
baseline_models.mechanism: Refusal has matured from an act into a hardened state no longer open to repair. Against a Lord characterized by gradual formation and completion, the shock manifests failed formation as a condition that takes the body and extinguishes ordinary awareness.

activation_trace.role: Terminal age or condition supplies hardening beyond easy repair.
Repair, nurture, and completion supply the formative relation being resisted.
A condition taking hold in the body turns seizure into embodied takeover.
Stupefaction or death gives the terminal state its bodily endpoint.

changed_reading.before: They break a rule and receive an external punishment.
changed_reading.after: Their refusal hardens into failed formation under the One who nurtures and repairs, until an overwhelming condition bodily realizes that terminal state.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The command root also carries a marker or appointment, and the looking root also carries waiting and granted delay.
baseline_models.mechanism: The lordly matter can be heard as bearing a marked threshold as well as an imperative. Those still waiting or expecting time are grasped when that threshold arrives as an overhead event.

activation_trace.role: A sign or appointed time supplies a latent temporal boundary within the command.
Grasping supplies the instant when open time becomes capture.
The descending crash materializes the marked threshold.
Waiting, expectation, and delay make their looking temporally charged.

changed_reading.before: The shock interrupts an otherwise unmarked act of sight.
changed_reading.after: An awaited or presumed interval expires: the marked lordly threshold takes them while they are still oriented toward more time.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding Pharaoh sequence sends compelling, disclosed authority, meets a turn away made with a strong support, and then takes ruler and mutually supporting force together. This revises the focus plural from isolated private disobedience toward power-backed refusal whose support system is implicated in the seizure.

activation_trace.role: Arrogant noncompliance remains the focus anchor for the parallel refusal.
Compelling proof makes the refused communication evidentially forceful.
Meaning disclosed by speech or sign removes obscurity as the primary cause of refusal.
Turning away supplies the neighboring behavioral analogue to departure from command.
A strong side leaned upon makes refusal structurally supported.
Capturing the ruler parallels the focus seizure as loss of agency.
A mutually supporting force broadens capture from an individual to his sustaining body.

structural_cues: 51:38-40 forms a send, turn, and take sequence immediately before the Thamud sequence.
The explicit inclusion of the ruler's force in 51:40 enlarges the object of taking.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a supported turn and collective capture; I transfer that social mechanism to the plural defiance in 51:44. A live alternative is that the parallel marks only repeated guilt, not a comparable support structure.

changed_reading.before: A group privately refuses and is struck.
changed_reading.after: The refusal can be read as socially supported resistance, and the taking as collapse of the resistant body together with the supports on which it relied.

context_deltas.mechanism: The adjacent punishment is sterile and converts what it reaches into decay. That material sequence sharpens the focus tension between terminal عتو and reparative رب: rebellion appears not only juridically wrong but anti-fruitful, ending in a state that can no longer be cultivated.

activation_trace.role: An irreparable terminal condition anchors the focus side of the analogy.
Nurture and repair provide the productive relation being negated.
The sterile wind supplies a material image of force without fruit.
Transformation into a new condition supplies the causal material transition.
Decay supplies the terminal material result.

structural_cues: Sterility and decay occupy the immediately preceding punishment account.
The focus follows with terminal-state and nurturing branch possibilities in direct tension.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sterile force, transformation, decay, terminality, and nurture; I infer an ecological analogy between failed cultivation and hardened refusal. The alternative is that the two punishment media are merely successive examples.

changed_reading.before: Their defiance is a discrete legal violation.
changed_reading.after: Their defiance has become sterile terminality: a refusal of formative nurture that ends in an uncultivable state.

context_deltas.mechanism: Before the focus, benefit is extended to a bounded time; after it, capacity, standing, and self-help vanish. The shock is the hinge where chosen noncompliance and presumed delay become imposed incapacity.

activation_trace.role: Waiting and granted delay make their looking the posture of an expiring respite.
A marker or appointment links command to the bounded interval.
Extended enjoyment supplies real but temporary continuance.
The proper time of a thing fixes the endpoint of continuance.
Obedient pliancy supplies the root-level counterpart they had refused.
Ability and capacity supply the post-shock faculty now absent.
Bodily standing gives incapacity a concrete vertical form.
Aid and self-vindicating support mark the social capacity also lost.

structural_cues: 51:43 grants enjoyment until a time, 51:44 is the seizure, and 51:45 states the resulting inability.
The shared طوع field juxtaposes voluntary pliancy with physical capacity.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies bounded enjoyment before and inability after; I identify the focus as the conversion point from chosen noncompliance to involuntary incapacity. The alternative is a simpler before-and-after chronology without a moral reversal in طوع.

changed_reading.before: The people are suddenly struck during sight.
changed_reading.after: They are taken at the expiry of a real respite, precisely where the ability they would not bend becomes an inability even to stand or secure help.

context_deltas.mechanism: The post-focus sequence builds by joining, empowers, expands, prepares, and measures creation. These constructive operations amplify the formative branch of رب and revise أمر from an isolated decree into direction situated within a sustaining order.

activation_trace.role: Nurture, repair, and completion anchor the focus in formative lordship.
The Lord's affair can encompass an ordered mode of governance.
Joining parts into a construction supplies coherent assembly.
Supporting strength supplies power that sustains the assembly.
Expansion against constriction supplies an open, ongoing scale.
Preparing and leveling an affair supplies habitable ordering.
Measuring a thing supplies proportion and purposive formation.

structural_cues: The discourse moves directly from failed standing to cosmic building, spreading, and measured creation.
Several constructive verbs follow the title رب in the focus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies constructive operations after judgment; I let them specify the formative scope of رب and أمر. A live alternative is that the creation sequence begins a new exhortation and should not causally explain the shock.

changed_reading.after: They reject direction embedded in the same formative order that assembles, strengthens, expands, prepares, and measures their world.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus movement is away from the Lord's command; the later imperative redirects flight toward God under an awakening and explicit warning. The seizure thus arrests a wrong-way vector, not merely a static refusal.

activation_trace.role: Departure from obedience supplies motion away from the command.
Grasping supplies the arrest of that outward motion.
Flight supplies urgent directed movement rather than passive assent.
The worshipped One supplies the destination of corrective flight.
Warning that awakens caution supplies urgency before capture.
Disclosed meaning makes the direction of escape explicit.

structural_cues: The focus construction uses عن for movement away, while 51:50 uses إلى for movement toward.
Both movements are attached to lordly or divine direction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposed prepositional vectors and the roots of departure, grasping, and flight; I read them as a directional reversal. The alternative is that عتو marks degree of disobedience without spatial force.

changed_reading.before: They refuse a command and are caught.
changed_reading.after: They travel morally in the wrong direction, away from command; the shock catches that flight before the later call identifies the only viable direction, toward God.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same labels recur around messengers, yet the text questions literal transmission and attributes recurrence to transgression. The focus defiance therefore becomes one local performance of a self-reproducing social voice that neutralizes warning by naming it away.

activation_trace.role: Arrogant noncompliance anchors the recurring script back in the focus.
Messenger and message supply the repeatedly targeted communication.
Speech spreading among people supplies social replication of the labels.
Deceptive diversion supplies one label used to displace the message.
A mind covered by madness supplies the alternative discrediting label.
Mutual bequeathing supplies the questioned model of direct transmission.
Exceeding the limit in disobedience supplies the stated generator of recurrence.
The raised collective voice supplies an exploratory image for communal amplification.

structural_cues: 51:52 repeats the exact sorcerer-or-madman pair already used in 51:39.
51:53 contrasts direct mutual bequeathing with a shared transgressive condition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated labels, questions direct transmission, and names transgression; I infer a social mechanism that independently reproduces the same dismissive voice. The alternative is simple historical recurrence without interpersonal amplification.

changed_reading.before: The focus community commits its own isolated act of defiance.
changed_reading.after: Its defiance participates in a recurring social script: communities amplify familiar labels until warning can be dismissed without being answered.

context_deltas.mechanism: Creation is directed toward humble service, while provision and feeding are explicitly not needed from creatures; the provider possesses gathered strength and extended solidity. The Lord's command in the focus is therefore formative for dependents, not extractive for a needy ruler.

activation_trace.role: Nurture and completion frame lordship as creature-forming care.
Binding direction supplies the creature-facing demand.
Humble obedience supplies the created relation that command is to form.
An apportioned gift marks provision as something creatures might wrongly imagine supplying.
Feeding another supplies the explicitly denied service to God.
Apportioned giving reverses the imagined direction of dependence.
Gathered strength like corded strands supplies self-sufficient power.
Extended solidity supplies durable, non-dependent capacity.

structural_cues: 51:56-58 states purpose, denies divine need, and identifies God as provider and strong.
These claims retrospectively specify the relation compressed in the focus title رب.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies created service, denied divine need, provision, and strength; I infer that the focus command benefits and forms the commanded rather than supplying the Commander. The alternative is to keep these later claims doctrinally true but separate from the earlier seizure.

changed_reading.before: A sovereign punishes subjects for withholding demanded service.
changed_reading.after: Dependents reject a formative command from the provider who needs nothing from them; the seizure exposes their dependence rather than repairing any lack in the Lord.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing warning gives wrongdoers a share figured as a full bucket like that of their companions, forbids hastening, and fixes a promised day. In contact with the focus appointment, waiting, and water-holding branches, the seizure becomes a measured allotment filling at its proper time.

activation_trace.role: Marker or appointment supplies a fixed point for the allotted event.
A basin that holds water supplies the exploratory receiving-container image.
Waiting and delay supply the temporal posture before the allotment arrives.
A share or portion supplies measured equivalence with predecessors.
A full bucket supplies the concrete image of a completed allotment.
Equivalence makes this allotment comparable to that of prior companions.
Hastening or advancing the event supplies the denied timing manipulation.
A bounded duration supplies the final temporal container.
An appointment fixed by time or place supplies the promised endpoint.

structural_cues: The surah closes by comparing a wrongdoer's portion with that of predecessors and by controlling its timing.
The focus is one predecessor event inside that closing comparison.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies share, full-bucket, equivalence, delay, and appointment images; I map the focus taking onto a container receiving its measured fill. The live alternative is that the bucket is only an idiom for share and should not materially color أخذ.

changed_reading.before: The shock is an unmeasured eruption that happens to overtake them.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, their seizure is the filling of an allotted share at a fixed time, continuous with the measured portions promised to comparable communities.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the grammar says the people look, whereas the cited branch personifies time as looking at and destroying people. It remains anchored in the focus looking root and its immediate seizure, but downstream prose should render it only as a secondary reversal-image, never as the clause's direct syntax.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The watchers are grasped by the destructive event at the instant of looking.

activation_trace.role: The destroying glance of time reverses sight back upon the watchers.
Grasping gives the reversed glance effective capture.
The overhead crash embodies the event that appears to look back.

changed_reading.before: They retain the one-way agency of spectators until impact.
changed_reading.after: As a contained image, their gaze is reversed: the destructive moment looks back, turns spectators into its objects, and takes them.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because رب is syntactically the Lord, not cloud or rising breath, and one image comes through the packet's non-dominant ر ب و mapping. It remains worth carrying as a sound-root echo linking title, body, and overhead crash; downstream prose must preserve the theological title and qualify the atmospheric layer as resonance only.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The title رب stands inside a scene of an overhead shock and exposed looking.

activation_trace.role: Layered cloud gives the lordship root an atmospheric echo without replacing its title sense.
Rising or swollen breath adds a bodily vertical response from the split mapping.
The upper crash joins the atmospheric and bodily echoes in one event.
A thing exposed to view makes the charged scene visibly present.

changed_reading.before: The divine title and the atmospheric shock occupy separate semantic planes.
changed_reading.after: As a qualified echo only, layered cloud, rising breath, overhead crash, and exposed view make lordship reverberate through the material scene.

strongest_changes: The focus becomes the hinge from bounded enjoyment to total incapacity, with طوع reversing refused pliancy into lost ability.
The opposed vectors عن and إلى recast defiance as wrong-way flight that seizure arrests.
The Pharaoh parallel broadens private refusal into support-backed resistance whose sustaining body can be taken with it.
Later purpose and provision language recasts the Lord's command as formative for dependents rather than extractive for a needy sovereign.
The closing share, full-bucket, and appointment field preserves an exploratory reading of the shock as a measured allotment arriving on time.
summary.what_was_special: The most productive activation came from reversals rather than topical similarity: obedience became inability, movement away answered movement toward, watchers became objects of a returning gaze, and an apparently abrupt strike became both expired respite and measured share.
remaining_uncertainties: The transfer from Pharaoh's explicit support structure to Thamud's plural defiance is analogical, not stated.
The constructive creation sequence may clarify formative lordship without directly explaining the earlier shock.
The container, returning-gaze, cloud, and rising-breath readings are branch-backed resonances and must not be promoted into direct lexical translations.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Overstepping a directive triggers overwhelming seizure.** `ع ت و/B001` supplies insolent refusal of obedience; `ء م ر/B002` command; `ر ب ب/B001` authority; `ء خ ذ/B001-2` seizure/accountability; `ص ع ق/B002` sky-borne thunderbolt. The packet supplies disobedience followed by taking; I infer **rejected command -> liability -> sudden seizure**. This historical scene materializes 51:4's distributed *amr* and 51:6's descending consequence.
2. **Looking does not become insight.** `ن ظ ر/B001` includes direct sight and reflective apprehension, yet the simultaneous clause leaves them watching when struck. I infer **spectacle without heed -> sight fails to convert into precaution**. This corrects any assumption from 51:20-21 that visible signs automatically produce certainty.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 51:55 supplied the correction to failed looking: visual exposure needs reminder and receptive assent before it becomes beneficial insight.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Watched time becomes witnessed boundary-enforcement.** **Lexical evidence:** fixed `ع ت و/B001` is insolent overstepping against obedience; fixed `ء م ر/B002` is command or directive; fixed `ء خ ذ/B002` is taking to account; fixed `ص ع ق/B002` is the sky-borne thunderbolt; fixed `ن ظ ر/B001` is directing sight to apprehend, while `B002` is watching for time. **Structural cue:** 51:43 grants enjoyment until a due occasion; 51:45 removes capacity to rise or self-aid, and 51:46–49 widen the frame to earlier transgression, strong construction, prepared earth, and paired creation. **Role and abduction:** overstepping crosses the command-boundary, the awaited occasion arrives as seizure, and sight makes that arrival contemporaneously perceptible; I infer that watching without obedient inference turns temporal awareness into helpless witnessing. **Reading change:** the closing phrase indicts failed interpretation, not lack of sensory access.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 51:45’s incapacity and 51:47–49’s visible construction, preparation, and pairing sharpened the failure: abundant order was available to sight, but looking did not become inference.

baseline.text: Rablerinin emrine karşı büyüklük tasladılar; bakıp dururlarken yıldırım onları yakaladı.

findings.text: Buyruğun sınırını kibirle aşmak, vadesi gelince gökten inen ani bir hesap sormayla sonuçlanır.
Olayı gözleriyle izlemek, görüleni düşünüp önleme çevirmedikleri için içgörü üretmeyen çaresiz tanıklığa dönüşür.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P3 (51:38-60): Elemental Unmaking and Lost Capacity
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Released force overtakes a population by progressively removing form, time, stance, and aid.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Wind and thunder do not merely destroy objects; they dismantle the predicates of agency, from remaining intact to standing and receiving help.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: The Measured Respite
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Enjoyment occupies a bounded interval before defiant excess meets the governing command.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: respite for enjoyment (`quranic:root_001395:B007/m01`); bounded interval (`quranic:root_000382:B001/m01`); defiant overreach (`quranic:root_000981:B001/m01`); command (`quranic:root_000051:B002/m01`); sovereign or master (`quranic:root_000532:B001/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The interval is permissive but not ownerless. Enjoyment fills measured time, overreach mistakes delay for independence, and the command reveals that the respite always remained bounded by another authority.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Blast, Collapse, and Failed Aid
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A thunderous seizure overtakes those still watching, stuns them, removes standing capacity, and forecloses rescue.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: forcible seizure (`quranic:root_000018:B001/m02`); thunderclap or lightning strike (`quranic:root_000864:B002/m01`); stunned or dead state (`quranic:root_000864:B003/m01`); watching (`quranic:root_001520:B001/m01`); ability (`quranic:root_000956:B003/m01`); standing (`quranic:root_001273:B002/m01`); stopped or exhausted incapacity (`quranic:root_001273:B016/m01`); aid (`quranic:root_001510:B001/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 51:44 `أَخَذَتْ` (ء خ ذ), `صَّٰعِقَةُ` (ص ع ق), `يَنظُرُ` (ن ظ ر); 51:45 `ٱسْتَطَٰعُ` (ط و ع), `قِيَامٍ` (ق و م), `مُنتَصِرِينَ` (ن ص ر).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The blast attacks agency in sequence. Observation remains for an instant, then seizure converts witnesses into the stunned; ability contracts into inability to stand, and social reinforcement disappears with the impossibility of aid.

identity_judgment.rationale: Dalın çerçevesi kaynak ifadesindeki ortak çekirdeği doğru yansıtır: kişi kibirlenerek itaate yanaşmaz, itaatten uzaklaşır ve bu kibirle sınırı aşar. Türemiş biçimlerdeki doğrudan itaatsizlik anlatımı bu çekirdeğin bir gerçekleşmesidir; bağımsız ve daha geniş bir anlam değildir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal sıradan itaatsizliği değil, kibirle birleşen itaat reddini ve buna bağlı sınır aşımını kapsar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın ad ve fiildeki kibirli itaat reddini temel alır; türemiş biçimlerdeki itaat etmeme ve karşı gelme kullanımlarını bu çekirdeğe bağlı tutar.

concept_map.definition: Kibirlenerek itaate yanaşmama, itaatten uzak durma ve bu tutumla konmuş sınırı aşmadır. Türemiş biçimlerde, bir kimsenin itaat etmemesi ve karşı gelmesi olarak gerçekleşir.

facets.statement: Temel durum, kibirlenme yüzünden itaate yanaşmamak ve itaatten uzak durmaktır.
Kibirli tutum, konmuş sınırı aşmaya kadar uzanabilir; sınır aşımı ancak bu koşulla dala bağlıdır.
Türemiş biçimler, belirli bir kişinin itaat etmemesini ve karşı gelmesini anlatır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların birleştirilmiş tanıklığı kibirlenmeyi anlamın belirleyici koşulu yapar; itaatten uzaklaşma, karşı gelme ve sınırı aşma bu tutumun bağlı görünümleridir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Kibirlenme, itaatten uzaklaşma ve buna bağlı sınır aşımı birlikte anlatılacağı zaman dalın bütün çekirdeğini karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Kibir koşulunu, itaatin reddini ve bu tutumun sınır aşımına varmasını birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Sınır aşımının ayrıca belirtilmediği, kibirli itaat reddinin öne çıktığı cümlelerde doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Kibirlenme ile itaate yanaşmama arasındaki temel bağı açıkça korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Davranışın açık bir otoriteye karşı çıkış olarak sunulduğu bağlamlarda kullanılabilir.

error_profile.preserves: Kibirli tutumu ve itaate karşı çıkışı görünür kılar.
error_profile.loses: Sınırı aşma uzantısını ve sessizce itaatten uzak durabilme ihtimalini belirtmez.
error_profile.collision: Başkaldırı, bağlama göre örgütlü ya da açık bir isyanı da düşündürebilir.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İtaat reddinin sonucu olarak ölçüyü veya konmuş sınırı aşmanın vurgulandığı cümlelere uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Sınır aşımını gelişigüzel değil, kibir koşuluna bağlı olarak anlatır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yalnızca yaşlı kişiyi anlatmaz; herhangi bir şeyin ilerleyip son sınırına varmasını da açıkça kapsar. Yaşlılık, bu genel son aşamaya ulaşma çekirdeğinin belirgin bir uzmanlaşmasıdır ve kişide ömrün gerileme dönemine girme ile giderilemez derecede ilerlemiş yaşlılık durumunu anlatır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal korunabilir, ancak yaşlılıkla sınırlandırılamaz; genel son aşamaya varma çekirdeği tanımda önce gelmelidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın fiilin bir şeyin son sınırına varması kapsamını, yaşlı kişiyle kurulan kullanımın ileri yaş ve gerileme kapsamından ayrı fakat bağlantılı tutar.

concept_map.definition: Bir kimse ya da şeyin ilerleyip son sınırına varmasıdır. Yaşlı kişi bağlamında, yaşlanıp ömrün gerileme dönemine girmeyi ve düzeltilmesi mümkün olmayacak ölçüde ilerlemiş bir yaşlılık durumunu anlatır.

facets.statement: Genel çekirdek, bir kimse veya şeyin ilerleyerek son sınırına ya da son aşamasına varmasıdır.
Yaşlı kişi için bu süreç, yaşlanmak ve ömrün gerileme dönemine girmek biçiminde gerçekleşir.
İleri yaş bağlamında sonuç, düzeltilmesi veya giderilmesi mümkün olmayan derecede ilerlemiş bir durumdur.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Birleştirilmiş kanıt iki kapsamı tek dalda toplar: herhangi bir şeyin son sınırına ulaşması ve bunun yaşlı kişide ileri yaşa, ömrün gerilemesine ve giderilemez bir duruma dönüşmesi.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi belirti, yol izi, küçük yol taşı ve belirlenmiş zaman ya da randevu anlamlarını aynı dalda verir. Geçici çerçeve hem gösterge hem belirlenmiş vakit yönünü korur ve buyruk ya da yönetim anlamını dışarıda bırakır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kanıt, bir şeyi gözeterek düzeltme, geliştirme ve aşama aşama tamamlanmış duruma getirme sürecini tutarlı biçimde gösterir. Çocuk yetiştirme, mülkü iyileştirme ve yapılan iyiliği tamamlama bu sürecin farklı nesneleridir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam yalnız bakım göstermeyi değil, gözetilen şeyi zaman içinde düzeltip tamamlamayı gerektirir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Eylemin yalın gelişim çekirdeği ile çocuk, mülk ve yapılan iyilik gibi nesnelere bağlı kullanımları ayrıştırılarak korunur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kanıt, çok sayıdaki insanın bir topluluk oluşturması ve ayrı kabilelerin tek bir birlik hâlinde toplanması çekirdeğini destekler. Sayı değeri ve belirli kabile birliği bu çekirdeğin özel gerçekleşmeleridir.

On bin kişilik topluluk ve beş kabilenin tek birlik olması tanıklanan özel örneklerdir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kanıt, önceki bir eşten olan çocuk ile o çocuğun bakımını üstlenen yeni eş arasındaki karşılıklı aile bağını destekler. Aynı dişil biçimin bakıcı kadın ve evde süt için beslenen hayvan anlamları da bulunduğundan bağlam ayrımı zorunludur.

branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس الرب بمعنى المالك أو السيد، ولا حرف رب
branches.source_phrase_ar: رب السمن والزيت: ثفله الأسود؛ سقاء مربوب إذا أصلح بالرب (jamhara); الرب: الطلاء الخاثر؛ سقاء مربوب؛ المرببات الأنبجات (sihah); رب فلان نحيه إذا جعل فيه الرب ومتنه به؛ نحي مربوب (tahdhib); رببت الأديم بالسمن، والدواء بالعسل، وسقاء مربوب (mufradat); هذا سقاء مربوب بالرب؛ الرب للعنب وغيره لأنه يرب به الشيء (maqayis)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kanıt, bir yere bağlanıp oradan ayrılmama çekirdeğini insan, deve ve bulut için destekler; süreklilik ve yaklaşma anlamları da kalıcılık eksenine bağlı yan gelişmelerdir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Temel sınır bir yerde kalma ve sürmedir; hareketin kendisi veya bulutun türü bu dalın çekirdeği değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yer, hayvan ve bulutla kurulan bağlı kullanımlar ayrı örnekler olarak korunur; bunlardan biri bütün dalın tek yalın anlamı yapılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir yerde kalıp oradan ayrılmamak veya bir durumun kesilmeden sürmesidir. Hayvanın bir eşe bağlanması ve bir şeye yaklaşma anlamı bu kalıcılık çekirdeğinin özel uzantılarıdır.

facets.statement: Kişi, hayvan veya başka bir varlık bulunduğu yere bağlanır ve oradan ayrılmaz.
Bulutun ya da rüzgârın sürmesi, kalıcılığın zamansal genişlemesidir.
Hayvanın eşe bağlanması ve bir şeye yaklaşma, çekirdeğe bağlı özel kullanımlardır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar yerde kalma, hayvanın belli yere veya eşe bağlanması, bulut ile rüzgârın sürmesi ve yaklaşmayı kalıcılık çevresinde toplar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Yer bağlılığı ile kesintisiz devamın ortak çekirdeğini anlatan genel bağlamlarda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Yerden ayrılmama, bağlı kalma ve süreklilik öğelerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin veya hayvan topluluğunun belirli yerde kalması bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Belirli yere bağlanma ve oradan ayrılmama sınırını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bulutun veya rüzgârın kesilmeden devam ettiği zamansal bağlamda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Bir durumun kesintisiz sürmesi anlamını korur.
Hareket etmeme ve bir yerde kalma yönünü korur.
error_profile.adds: Geçici duraklama ve yalnız hareketsizlik gibi kalıcılık gerektirmeyen durumları ekler.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bulutun sürmesi, hayvanın bağlanması ve bir şeye yaklaşma uzantıları odak dalda bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da kişinin belirli bir yerde kalıp ayrılmamasını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: İnsan için yerleşik kalma alanında güçlü biçimde örtüşürler; odak dal aynı çekirdeği hava olaylarına, hayvan davranışına ve yaklaşmaya genişletir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; yerden ayrılmama çekirdeğini en yakın biçimde paylaşan aday seçildi, yalnız süre, hareketsizlik veya hareket alanını paylaşanlar yayımlanmadı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه رب أو أرب بالمكان إذا أقام، ومرب الإبل ومرابها، وأربت السحابة أو الجنوب إذا دامت، والإرباب بمعنى الدنو
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس السحاب نفسه إذا سمي ربابا، ولا شاة رُبّى خاصة
branches.source_phrase_ar: رب بالمكان وأرب إذا أقام به (jamhara); مرب الإبل حيث لزمته؛ أربت الإبل؛ أربت الناقة؛ أربت الجنوب والسحابة أي دامت؛ الأرباب الدنو (sihah); أرب فلان بالمكان إذا أقام به فلم يبرحه؛ مرب الإبل أي حيث لزمته (tahdhib); أربت السحابة: دامت؛ أرب فلان بمكان كذا (mufradat); الأصل الآخر لزوم الشيء والإقامة عليه؛ أربت السحابة؛ الإرباب الدنو (maqayis)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kanıt, birbirine binmiş ya da aşağıda asılı duran bir bulut kümesini ortak kimlik olarak destekler. Beyazlık bazı tanıklıklarda belirtilse de başka tanıklıklar siyah olabileceğini söylediğinden renk tanımın zorunlu öğesi değildir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal bulutun yapısını ve konumunu anlatır; renk ile yağmur veya bitki yetiştirme sonucu zorunlu tanım öğesi değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım doğrudan bulut kümesi anlamıyla sınırlıdır; yağmurun kendisi veya yalnız yağış zamanı bu yalın anlama taşınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Parçaları birbirine binmiş ya da başka bulutların altında asılı duran bulut kümesidir; beyaz veya siyah olabilir.

facets.statement: Bulut parçaları üst üste binmiş veya aşağıda asılı duran belirgin bir küme oluşturur.
Beyazlık bazı tanıklıklarda öne çıkar, ancak renk bütün kullanımlar için sabit değildir.
Bitkiyi besleyen yağmurla ilişkilendirilmesi adlandırmanın açıklaması olarak verilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar üst üste binmiş veya aşağıda asılı duran bulut yapısında birleşir; renk konusunda beyazlık ile renk değişkenliği arasında fark bulunur.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bulutun parçalı, üst üste binmiş veya aşağıda asılı yapısını anlatan genel karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Bulut olma, katmanlaşma ve asılı durma özelliklerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bulut parçalarının birbirine binerek bir küme oluşturduğu görünüm için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Bulutun katmanlı ve birleşik yapısını korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: beyaz olabilen, katmanlı veya aşağıda asılı bulut

error_profile.preserves: Bulut ve yağışla ilişki yönünü korur.
error_profile.adds: Yağmur taşıma zorunluluğu ekler ve katmanlı ya da asılı yapı sınırını belirsizleştirir.
error_profile.collision: Her yağmur bulutunun bu özel yapıda olduğu izlenimini doğurur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bulutun parçalarının üst üste binmesi veya başka bulutların altında asılı durması odak dala özgüdür.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Su yüklü olma, siyahlık ve göksel burçla ilişki komşu dalın ek kapsamıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da belirgin ve yoğun bir bulut oluşumunu gösterebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal yapısal katmanlaşma ve asılı konumla tanımlanır; komşu dal ise su taşıma, koyu renk ve göksel işaret ilişkisini öne çıkarır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; bulut türleri arasında yapısal sınırı en açık gösteren aday seçildi, doğrudan yağmur veya mevsimsel yağış bildiren adaylar dışarıda bırakıldı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الرباب والربابة للسحاب، والسحاب المتعلق أو المركب بعضه على بعض، وما سمي بذلك لتربية النبات أو دوام المطر
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس الربابة وعاء القداح، ولا الربابة العهد
branches.source_phrase_ar: الرباب: سحاب أبيض؛ الواحدة ربابة (sihah); الربابة: السحابة التي قد ركب بعضها بعضا؛ جمعها رباب (tahdhib); الرباب: السحاب، سمي بذلك لأنه يرب النبات (mufradat); سمي السحاب ربابا؛ السحاب المتعلق دون السحاب يكون أبيض ويكون أسود (maqayis)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kanıt, yakın zamanda gerçekleşmişlik, tazelik ve başlangıç evresi çekirdeğini destekler. Yeni doğurmuş ve süt için evde tutulan koyun özel bir uygulama, gençliğin başlangıcı ise insan yaşamına taşınmış bir kullanımdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Yeni doğurmuş koyun, tazelik ve gençliğin başlangıcı aynı düzeyde bağımsız çekirdekler değil; ilk durum genel yenilik sınırının özel gerçekleşmesidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yeni doğurmuş koyun ve gençliğin başlangıcı gibi bağlı kullanımlar ayrı tutulur; bunlar her yalın biçime sınırsızca genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin henüz başlangıcında, yeni ve taze olmasıdır. Yeni doğurmuş koyun ile gençliğin ilk dönemi bu yakın zamanlılık niteliğinin özel uygulamalarıdır.

facets.statement: Temel nitelik yakın zamanda başlamış olma, yenilik ve tazeliktir.
Yeni doğurmuş veya süt için evde tutulan koyun, doğum sonrası yenilik durumunu taşır.
Gençliğin ilk evresi, başlangıç ve tazelik çekirdeğinin insan yaşamına genişlemesidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar yeni doğurmuş koyunu, bir şeyin ilk ve taze dönemini ve gençliğin başlangıcını yakın zamanda başlamış olma ortaklığında toplar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir varlık veya dönemin henüz yeni başlamış ve taze olduğu genel bağlamlarda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Başlangıç, yenilik ve tazelik öğelerini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Doğumun üzerinden az zaman geçmiş veya sütü için evde tutulan koyun ve keçi için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Hayvanın doğum sonrası yakın zamanlı durumunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İnsan yaşamında gençliğin yeni başladığı dönemi anlatır.

error_profile.preserves: Gençlik döneminin başlangıç ve tazelik niteliğini korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: yeni doğurmuş veya sütü için evde tutulan koyun
bir şeyin yeni ve taze dönemi

error_profile.preserves: İnsan yaşamındaki erken dönem yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Genel yenilik ve tazelik ile yeni doğurmuş hayvan kapsamını kaybeder.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Yeni doğurmuş ve süt için evde tutulan koyun odak dalın özel kullanım alanıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Genç kişi ve başlangıç durumundaki çok çeşitli nesneler komşu dalda daha geniş biçimde yer alır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bir şeyin başlangıçta, yakın zamanlı ve taze olmasını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Genel yenilik alanında örtüşürler; odak dal doğum sonrası koyun ve gençliğin ilk dönemiyle belirginleşirken komşu dal yaş ve nesne bakımından daha geniştir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; genel tazelik ile doğum sonrası özel kullanım arasındaki sınırı gösteren aday seçildi, yalnız süt, gebelik veya emzirme alanını paylaşanlar alınmadı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الشاة الرُّبّى والرباب لقرب العهد بالولادة أو لزوم البيت للبن، وربان الشيء بمعنى حدثانه وطراءته، وربى الشباب
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس مطلق لزوم المكان، ولا الربيبة للولد المربوب
branches.source_phrase_ar: الربى: الشاة التي وضعت حديثا؛ قرب العهد بالولادة؛ بربانه أي بحدثانه وجدته وطراءته (sihah); الربى: أول الشباب؛ الربان من كل شيء: حدثانه؛ الشاة فهي ربى (tahdhib); الشاة الربي التي تحتبس في البيت للبن؛ التي وضعت حديثا (maqayis)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kanıt, kura veya kumar oklarını bir arada tutan deri parçası, bez ya da okluk benzeri kabı tutarlı biçimde gösterir. Okların topluca kendisi de kabın bir araya getirme işlevinden doğan yakın kullanımdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal tek bir ok veya kura çubuğunu değil, bunları bir arada tutan kap ya da topluluğu anlatır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnız ok ve kura çubuklarını toplayan kap ile toplu oklar anlamında kalır; tek tek ok adlarına genişlemez.

concept_map.definition: Kura veya kumarda kullanılan ok ve çubukları bir arada tutan deri ya da bez kap; buna bağlı olarak kabın içindeki okların topluluğudur.

facets.statement: Deri veya bezden yapılan kap, kura oklarını ve çubuklarını bir arada tutar.
Kabın içindeki okların topluluğu, kapsayan nesneden kapsanana geçen kullanımdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar deri parçası, bez veya okluğa benzer kap anlatımında birleşir ve kura oklarının topluluğunu bununla bağlantılı olarak verir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Kura veya kumar oklarının konduğu deri ya da bez kabı anlatan temel karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Kap olma, okları toplama ve kura bağlamını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kabın kendisinden çok içinde bir araya getirilmiş okların bütünü kastedildiğinde uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Okların tek tek değil toplu hâlde bulunması yönünü korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: kura oklarını bir arada tutan deri veya bez kap

error_profile.preserves: Okları içinde toplama ve taşıma işlevini korur.
error_profile.adds: Savaş ve av oklarına özgü genel taşıma kabı anlamını ekler.
error_profile.collision: Kura ve kumar bağlamındaki özel kap ile sıradan ok kabını karıştırır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Kura çubuklarını bir arada tutan kap ve onların toplu hâli odak dala özgüdür.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Uç ve tüy takılmamış tek ok gövdesi ya da tek kura çubuğu komşu dalın çekirdeğidir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da kura veya kumarda kullanılan ok biçimli çubuklarla ilgilidir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal çubukları toplayan kap veya takım düzeyindedir; komşu dal ise tek bir çubuğun kendisini adlandırır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; kap ile içindeki tek çubuk arasındaki temel ayrımı gösteren aday seçildi, belirli sıra okları ve oyunun bütünü tekrara yol açmamak için alınmadı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الربابة للجلدة أو الوعاء الذي تجمع فيه القداح أو سهام الميسر، وجماعة السهام نفسها
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليست الربابة العهد، ولا الرباب السحاب
branches.source_phrase_ar: الربابة: قطعة من أدم تجمع فيها القداح (jamhara); الربابة شبيهة بالكنانة تجمع فيها سهام الميسر؛ جماعة السهام (sihah); الربابة: جماعة السهام؛ الجلدة التي تجمع فيها السهام (tahdhib); لما يجمع فيه القدح ربابة (mufradat); الخرقة التي يجعل فيها القداح ربابة (maqayis)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kanıt, tarafları birbirine bağlayan sözleşme, güvence ve bağlılık düzenini ortak çekirdek olarak destekler. Vergi veya onda bir pay anlamı, alındığında bağlayıcı söz gibi işlemesiyle açıklanan ikincil bir uzantıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Ana anlam karşılıklı bağlılık doğuran söz ve güvencedir; vergi payı ancak bu bağlayıcılığa dayanan özel kullanımdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım doğrudan sözleşme, güvence ve ona bağlı insanlar alanında kalır; aynı biçimdeki kap veya bulut anlamları dışarıda tutulur.

concept_map.definition: İnsanları karşılıklı bağlılık, güvence veya dayanışma içinde birleştiren sözleşme ve verilmiş sözdür. Bu sözleşmeye bağlı kişiler ile söz gibi bağlayıcı sayılan vergi payı da ilişkili kullanımlardır.

facets.statement: Karşılıklı söz ve güvence, taraflar arasında bağlayıcı bir ilişki kurar.
Sözleşmeye bağlı kişiler bu bağın tarafları olarak topluca adlandırılır.
Vergi veya onda bir pay, bağlayıcı söz gibi işlediği açıklamasıyla aynı alana genişler.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar sözleşme, verilmiş söz, güvence ve ona bağlı kişileri ortak bir bağlayıcılık altında toplar; vergi payını açıklamalı bir uzantı olarak ekler.

concept_gloss.applicability: Tarafları karşılıklı bağlılık ve koruma ilişkisine sokan sözleşme için genel karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Söz verme, bağlayıcılık, güvence ve tarafları birleştirme öğelerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Verilmiş söz veya güvence düzeninin tarafları topluca kastedildiğinde uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Kişilerin aynı bağlayıcı söz çevresinde birleşmesini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Vergi veya onda bir payın sözleşmeye benzer bağlayıcılıkla adlandırıldığı özel kullanım içindir.

error_profile.preserves: Vergi payı ile bağlayıcı söz arasındaki açıklanmış ilişkiyi korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: tarafları birleştiren bağlayıcı söz veya sözleşme
bağlayıcı söz; söz gibi bağlayıcı vergi payı

error_profile.preserves: Taraflar arasında bağlayıcı söz kurulması yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Güvence, bağlı kişiler ve vergi payına uzanan kullanım alanını kaybeder.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Sözleşmeye bağlı kişilerin toplu adı ve vergi payına yapılan uzantı odak dalda bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Yemin, güvenli geçiş, korunan hak alanı ve söz veren kişinin nitelenmesi komşu dalda daha geniştir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da verilmiş söz, sözleşme, güvence ve bu güvenceye bağlı taraflar alanında örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal insanları bir araya getiren bağ ve onun taraflarını öne çıkarır; komşu dal sözün korunması, yemin ve güvenlik sonuçlarını daha geniş kapsar.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; sözleşme ve güvence çekirdeğini en yakın paylaşan aday seçildi, sözün kurulması, bozulması veya yalnız vekâlet alanındaki adaylar dışarıda bırakıldı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الربابة والرباب للعهد والميثاق والجوار، والأربة للمعاهدين، والرباب للعشور إذا جعل كالعهد
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليست الربابة وعاء القداح، ولا الرباب السحاب
branches.source_phrase_ar: الربابة: العهد والمعاهدون أربة (jamhara); الربابة: العهد والميثاق؛ الأربة أهل الميثاق (sihah); الرباب: العهد؛ الرباب: العشور (tahdhib); العقد في موالاة الغير: الربابة (mufradat); الربابة وهو العهد؛ للمعاهدين أربة؛ الرباب العشور (maqayis)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kanıt belirli bir bitki ya da birkaç bitki için kullanılan adı destekler, ancak bunun ağaç, genel bitki veya yumuşak ot oluşunda tanıklıklar aynı ayrıntıyı vermez. Yazın kurumadan yeşil kalma yalnız bazı tanıklıklarda belirtilir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal genel olarak bütün yeşil bitkileri değil, adı bu biçimde verilen bir veya birkaç belirli bitki türünü kapsar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım doğrudan tanıklanan bitki adıyla sınırlıdır; genel otluk, ağaçlık veya bütün yaz yeşil kalan bitkiler anlamına genişletilmez.

concept_map.definition: Yumuşak ot, başka bir bitki veya küçük ağaç olarak betimlenen belirli bir bitki adıdır; bazı türlerinin yazın kurumadan yeşil kaldığı belirtilir.

facets.statement: Ad, genel bitki sınıfını değil belirli bir bitki ya da bitki grubunu gösterir.
Bitkinin ot, başka bir bitki veya ağaç sayılması tanıklıklara göre değişir.
Yumuşaklık ve yazın kurumadan yeşil kalma bazı tanımlarda ayırt edici özelliktir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar bunun belirli bir bitki adı olduğunda birleşir; ot, ağaç ve yumuşak yazlık yeşil bitki betimleri arasında kapsam farkı bırakır.

Başka bir kullanımda çözülmesi güç, sıkıca bağlanmış düğümü bildirir.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal genel artma ve yükselmeyi kapsar; belirli bir yer biçimini, alışveriş hükmünü veya solunum rahatsızlığını kendi başına tanımlamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Genel artma ve yükselme çekirdeği ile belirli yapılardaki köpük, şiddet ve birinin üstünde bulunma kullanımları ayrı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin miktar, hacim, düzey veya konum bakımından önceki durumunun üstüne çıkmasıdır. Bu yükseliş büyüme, kabarma, şiddetlenme ya da başka bir şeyin üzerinde bulunma biçiminde gerçekleşebilir.

facets.statement: Bir şey nicelikçe artar veya düzeyce yükselir.

Birinin ya da bir şeyin ötekinden daha yukarıda bulunmasına uzanır.
